description: Agent GPU topologies as the master's API returns them, with the summary strings they give in the GPU Topology and GPU Health columns of det agent list and, where pcieLink is given, the PCIe link of each GPU in its details, in the order of gpuTopology.gpus. Shared by harness/tests/cli/test_agent.py and webui/react/src/utils/gpuTopology.test.ts, so the CLI and the WebUI show the same strings.
